title: Unused Share on Rental Sale Cancellations Measured from the Sale Closing
content:
**Rule.** The unused share used for a Rental Property Service Contracts sale cancellation credit follows how soon notice followed the sale closing:

1. When notice was given no more than 7 days after the closing date, the unused days are counted from the day after the closing date through the period's last day, but never more than the period's days.
2. When notice was given more than 30 days after the closing date, the unused days after the notice date are counted down to whole weeks: the whole number of 7-day weeks in them, times 7.
3. Otherwise, the unused days are the calendar days after the notice date through the period's last day.

In every case the unused share is those unused days divided by the period's days counted from its first day through its last day inclusive. The period is the billing period in which notice was given.

**Records read.** The property sale closing date and the notice date on the cancellation request; the period's first and last day on its monthly installment charge.

## Days from closing to notice

| Days after the closing date | Unused days |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 | from the day after the closing, capped at the period's days |
| 8 to 30 | after the notice date |
| 31 or more | after the notice date, counted down to whole weeks |

## Hypothetical cancellations (billing period 15 April to 14 May, 30 days)

- Closing 28 April, notice 4 May (6 days after): unused days 29 April to 14 May, 16; share 16 divided by 30.
- Closing 10 April, notice 15 April (5 days after): days after the closing through 14 May are 34, capped at 30; share one.
- Closing 1 April, notice 4 May (33 days after): 10 days after the notice, 1 whole week, 7 days; share 7 divided by 30.
- Closing 20 April, notice 4 May (14 days after): 10 days; share 10 divided by 30.
